thread:
Oliver: Orion Finance reached out: they need streaming scoring, function/tool calls for safe enrichment, strict JSON schema outputs, and a completed security questionnaire. Can we align on blockers and next steps?
Emma (SalesEng): Quick list: SSE or websocket streaming, function/tool integration (lookup service), schema enforcement on responses, BYOK + on-prem option.
Raj (Solutions): For streaming we typically recommend SSE with reconnect. Toolcalls work via our function-call events in the stream. Minimal example: `const ev = new EventSource("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-redwood-1"); ev.onmessage = e => console.log(e.data);`
Oliver: They worry about partial JSON fragments breaking validators.
Raj: We stream structured fragments with `__chunk_id` and a final `validation_result`. Client assembles chunks before validation.
Leila (Security): Questionnaire Qs: support for customer-managed KMS, audit log retention, can we disable token persistence?
Emma: BYOK is supported on Private/Dedicated; hosted enterprise can use envelope integration. We have a no-persist option under enterprise contract (operations sign-off required).
Oliver: Pricing ballpark for 100 qps (steady), ~2M tokens/day, 50k toolcalls?
Raj: 2M/day ~= 60M/mo. Preliminary reserved estimate $10k-$20k/mo depending on SLAs and dedicated capacity. Flag finance for exact.
deploy-bot: checklist created: sales/integrations/1779992333-orion-poc-checklist.md
Oliver: Blockers: their corporate proxy requires client certs; SAML for console; want on-prem installer checklist.
Raj: mTLS supported on Private; hosted requires customer-side proxy to terminate certs. SAML 2.0 supported.
Leila: I'll draft the questionnaire answers (SOC2, encryption, retention, deletion, HSM options) and share by EOD tomorrow.
Emma: Action items: Emma -> confirm pricing with finance; Raj -> publish quickstart SSE + toolcall sample and a one-page runbook; Leila -> questionnaire answers; Oliver -> schedule call with Orion to discuss proxy and SSO.
Oliver: Thanks team. I'll loop in finance and legal and set the kickoff. :thumbsup:
